cases.prompt: Deliver an approved multi-file React Native feature using small batches, checkpoints, tests, and final runtime evidence.
expect: Uses the approved SDD and preserves unrelated changes
Runs bounded validation after coherent batches and classifies failures
Reports static, test, runtime, and residual-risk evidence

expect: Returns the blocker, attempts, and evidence
Does not weaken tests or silently claim completion
